assets.theme: Dough Scoring: Raw Cut and Baked Ear Comparison
assets.palette: oat cream, pale dough, baked amber, graphite
assets.prompt: Build a horizontal 16:9 reference plate at 4K for a sourdough lesson or a flour brand technique guide. Place two similarly sized, oblong bread forms on an unbroken oat cream field, one on the left and one on the right, with matching viewing angles and matching long axes. On the left, show raw shaped dough with a thin skin, a faint dusting of flour, and one relaxed diagonal incision that opens slightly into pale dough. On the right, render the same silhouette after baking, with a raised amber ear created by that incision and a crumbly ridge following the same direction. Work in dry gouache with sparse colored pencil marks and believable pores, lit by a broad window from the upper left. Reserve a clear strip above each form for buyer supplied captions and keep the central gutter unmarked for cropping or separate layout placement. Keep edges clean at full size and omit utensils, lettering, trademarks, and decoration.
assets.negative_prompt: knife, hands, wheat ornaments, flour explosion, mirrored cuts, exaggerated hollow loaf, labels, logos

assets.theme: Extruded Aluminum Heat Sink with Open Fin Channels
assets.palette: satin silver, cool gray, slate, chalk
assets.prompt: Create a 4K horizontal 16:9 industrial illustration for a thermal component catalog or an engineering lesson on passive air cooling. Show a short, generic aluminum extrusion from a shallow three quarter angle, looking down the length of the open fin channels. Use a flat integral base and straight parallel fins with constant spacing and realistic thickness. The near end faces should reveal subtle extrusion grain and deburred edges, with darker reflected tones only where surfaces shelter one another. Place the component entirely in the left 54 percent, slightly below center, on a cool light gray field with a narrow contact shadow. Leave the right side clear for an editor to add a parts legend and keep the perimeter safe for a thumbnail crop. Use restrained product illustration, satin metal, and one broad overhead softbox that preserves the fin openings. Deliver a single opaque artwork with crisp silhouettes and omit arrows, gauges, text, branding, fasteners, and electronics.
assets.negative_prompt: CPU, circuit board, fan, colored arrows, warped fins, chrome reflection, digits, logos

assets.theme: Tucked Gift Wrap Seam with Twin Diagonal Folds
assets.palette: cranberry, oat cream, warm red, rosewood
assets.prompt: Illustrate a tucked gift wrapping seam as a quiet vertical 9:16 design component for a retailer gift wrap option or a holiday story card. Work at 4K and show only two converging folding creases and a flat tucked flap with a narrow wedge of exposed reverse near the lower left. Use matte cranberry paper with a warm oat reverse, fine fibers aligned with the sheet, and a slim highlight where the fold has compressed the pigment. Let the intact sheet become the background, and make the central and upper right area an even low contrast red for added pricing or instructions. Keep the seam away from the bottom interface margin and place all hard edges below the lower half. Use soft oblique studio light from the upper left and use a fine contact shadow where the upper flap slips under the lower fold. Preserve the physical paper thickness and avoid ribbons, gift boxes, text, logos, foil, confetti, and overt seasonal symbols.
assets.negative_prompt: box, bow, ribbon, printed holly, snowfall, ornate frame, torn edge, labels

assets.theme: Sedimentary Strata Specimen with Blank Correlation Field
assets.palette: clay rose, buff sandstone, shale gray, warm ivory
assets.prompt: Compose a horizontal 16:9 teaching plate at 4K for a geology workbook or a small museum label. Place a generic rectangular rock specimen in the left half, front face nearly square to the camera and a narrow right edge visible to give the block thickness. Show five undisturbed horizontal strata with naturally variable thickness. Render a coarse buff sandstone bed with visible rounded grains, quieter gray silt rich beds and one narrow compact clay colored seam. Let every boundary continue consistently around the small side face. Use natural history lithographic illustration with fine stipple, a warm ivory paper field and broad neutral daylight. Keep the full right 45 percent quiet so designers can align their own callouts with each bed, and leave breathing room around the specimen for cropping into print. Keep small grains legible without adding gloss. Omit fossils, landscape, interpretive arrows, dates, lettering and identifiers.
assets.negative_prompt: mountains, fossils, lava glow, tilted faults, map scale, rainbow bands, text, logo

assets.theme: Demountable Timber Joint with Withdrawn Machine Bolt
assets.palette: birch, charcoal gray, pewter, warm stone
assets.prompt: Draw a 4K horizontal 16:9 workshop manual plate for a furniture repair booklet or a design for disassembly lecture. Show two unbranded birch blocks meeting at a simple butt joint. A small section of one block is cut away to expose a steel threaded insert seated flush in its bore. Align a single partially withdrawn machine bolt on the exact same axis, and show the coarse wood gripping exterior of the insert separately from its finer interior machine thread. Keep the bolt, insert and blocks in the left two thirds and reserve the right third for a short caption or replacement part list. Use restrained mechanical linework, soft graphite shading, muted pewter highlights and fine wood grain that follows the boards. Light from high left to keep the inner bore readable. Leave good outer margins for manual layout and crop. Omit dimension arrows, tool branding, text, glue and distracting workshop props.
assets.negative_prompt: trademarked fittings, screws through air, mismatched threads, ghost bolts, dimensions, writing

assets.theme: Tuning Fork with Restrained Prong Motion Traces
assets.prompt: Make a 4K 16:9 scientific illustration for a lesson on sound or a museum activity card. Show one neutral steel tuning fork in near frontal view, with upright parallel tines, a rounded U junction and a short centered stem. Set it in the left half on an ivory field, with a quiet right half reserved for teaching annotations. Show the motion at the tips with only two narrow pairs of faint graphite traces. The two tips shift toward one another or away from one another in opposite directions, and the faint marks taper out toward the base. Keep the main fork completely sharp, with believable brushed steel, subtle edge highlights, and diffuse light that never hides its contours. Preserve margins for cropping the figure by itself or embedding the whole plate. Avoid arrows, wave graphics, musical notes, numbers, brand markings and decorative objects.
assets.negative_prompt: ear diagram, water splash, glow, musical notes, waveform chart, hands, arrows, text

assets.theme: Sixfold Paper Cutout Stencil beside Its Folded Wedge
assets.palette: winter blue, slate blue, cotton white, soft gray
assets.prompt: Create a horizontal 16:9 craft plate at 4K for a winter workshop guide or an educational layout on paper symmetry. Place a modest geometric snowflake cut from matte white cotton paper near the left third and a slim folded paper wedge near the right third. Keep the flat snowflake structurally connected, with exactly six repeated radial sectors and a few rounded triangles cut through the paper. Let two cut details on the folded wedge suggest the same shapes visible in the open form. Use a muted winter blue opaque field and soft angled light so that the thin paper edges cast a short believable shadow. Include sparse fibers and slightly compressed creases as construction evidence. Keep both forms within the crop margins, with a clear gutter and generous space above for buyer added captions. Omit glitter, holiday characters, printed words, logos and unrelated decorations.
assets.negative_prompt: random branch counts, disconnected leaves, plastic glitter, borders, text, labels, logos
